demo.lead: After a Learning session you explain the topic in your own words. You get a clarity score, what’s missing, what’s off, and questions for your reviews.
demo.label: Example of an explanation with AI feedback
demo.explanation: Plants make their own food. Their leaves catch sunlight, take water from the roots and air through tiny holes, and turn it into sugar. The leftover is oxygen, which we breathe.
demo.gap: Missing: the gas from the air is carbon dioxide.
demo.mistake: Unclear: the sunlight provides energy; it isn’t turned into sugar itself.
demo.q1: Which gas do plants take from the air to make sugar?
demo.q2: True or false: plants release oxygen as a by-product.
demo.q3: Plants use the energy of ____ to make sugar.

points.1: All techniques, tasks, stats and reminders on Free
points.2: Pro: unlimited cards and AI feedback for every card
points.3: Pro: the full Lab and a weekly report

1.a: Not for Work mode: just start the timer. Learning mode needs a free account so we can save your cards and send review reminders.

2.a: FocusKept runs in your browser on any device. You can install it to your home screen, and reminders arrive by email and browser notifications.

3.q: How does the AI use my explanation?
3.a: Your explanation is sent to OpenAI to generate feedback and questions. Don’t include personal or sensitive information. Details are in our privacy policy.

4.a: Reviews spread over the first month, when forgetting is fastest, keep knowledge for the long term with little effort. You can change the steps in Settings.

5.a: FocusKept is available in 24 languages. Your explanations and questions work in any language you write in.

1.q: What happens to my cards if I stop paying?
1.a: Nothing is lost. Your cards and scheduled reviews keep working. You can’t add more cards beyond the Free limit, and AI analyses return to 10 a month.

2.q: What does fair use mean for AI on Pro?
2.a: Pro includes AI feedback for up to 300 cards a month, far more than most people create. If you reach it, you can still write questions yourself.

3.a: Open Billing in the app and choose Manage subscription. You keep Pro until the end of the period you paid for.

4.a: Polar acts as our merchant of record and handles payment, invoices and sales tax. FocusKept never sees your card details.

5.a: Not at the moment. Pro is available monthly or yearly.
